name: Mount Alphus
title: Mount Alphus
summary: The Mount Alphus summit: a 130 x 160 m mesa at 224 m with cliffs on every side. It holds the Mount Alphus Menhir Ring (five standing stones with a Menhir Mana Field and mushroom circle) 35 m from the east rim, the tent of Zalphoos the Shopkeeper, a well, ferns, and the Base of Mt. Alphus and South Zabool portals.

landmarks.name: Mount Alphus Menhir Ring
landmarks.note: Five standing stones (0x02000374 x3, 0x02000375 x2), Menhir Mana Field and mushroom circle.

landmarks.name: Tent of Zalphoos the Shopkeeper
landmarks.note: Tent 0x01000EDC with a well 7 m west.

site.name: Mount Alphus
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer mount-alphus (north end of the plateau by the South Zabool portal, 100 m from the menhir ring). [critic b4-7 2026-10-15: teleport changed from '@teleloc 0x95980029 140.2 15.9 224 -0.317305 0 0 -0.948324' because the gazetteer drop was 3.0 m from the South Zabool portal (weenieType Portal). Derived drop 9 m south-west on flat summit ground (224.0, level within 1 m for 12 m around), 11.8 m from the portal, 10.2 m from any drawn object. Cell index = floor(lx/24)*8+floor(ly/24)+1, z = ground + 0.5.]

shots.standingOrder: Hold 0.7 m above the plateau 9 m south-west of the Mount Alphus Menhir Ring, look up through the standing stones at the sky and push 1.2 m in; never closer than 3 m to any stone.
shots.notes: Heroic low angle through the Mount Alphus Menhir Ring - five 2.9-3.7 m standing stones around the Menhir Mana Field and a mushroom circle - looking north-east so the stones stand against open sky with the east cliff edge 35 m beyond; the south-west afternoon sun behind the lens lights the stone faces.
